claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on Friday, April 10, 2026, at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
Live coverage of the Artemis II return is available on NASA+ and various streaming platforms starting around 6:30 p.m. EDT.
The crew module separates from the service module at 7:33 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
Atmospheric entry occurs at 7:53 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
The capsule hits the atmosphere at 24,000+ mph.
Recovery teams from NASA and the U.S. Navy will be stationed near San Diego to retrieve the crew from the "Integrity" capsule.
